parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they share only the structural shape of being a zero-field type alias — not any actual content or domain meaning. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package, Observation layer), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package, two distinct player subsystems), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package, RequestService) each encode a distinct domain event in unrelated subsystems. The `shared_field_count: 1` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` confirms the only commonality is the empty-body shape, not any shared fields or logic. Merging or extracting these would conflate unrelated domain concepts and introduce artificial coupling across Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit packages.
